D1.contract: KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H25 (Hike 25bps) plus KXFEDDECISION-26DEC-H26 (Hike >25bps), December 2026 FOMC meeting
D1.match_note: Same meeting (Dec 9, 2026), same event (any hike). Sum of the two hike buckets: 25bp bid/ask 0.92/0.93 plus >25bp 0.03/0.04, about 96%. Polymarket 'Fed Decision in December?' gives 93.5% (25bp) plus 2.2% (50bp+), about 96%, in agreement. Kalshi KXFED-26DEC-T4.00 (upper bound above 4.00%) also 0.95/0.96.

D2.contract: KXFEDDECISION-27JAN-H25 (Hike 25bps) plus KXFEDDECISION-27JAN-H26 (Hike >25bps), January 2027 FOMC meeting
D2.match_note: Same meeting (Jan 27, 2027), any hike: 25bp bid/ask 0.56/0.57 plus >25bp 0.02/0.03, about 59%. The market is the unconditional odds of a January hike; our event also needs the Dec 9 hike, which the market prices at 96%, so the gap is about 2 points at most. Polymarket 'Fed Decision in January?' prices the 25bp hike at 54.5%.

D3.contract: Will the Fed hike-hike-hike in the next three decisions (Dec-Jan-Mar)?
D3.match_note: Same three meetings (Dec 9, Jan 27, Mar 17) and same path: three straight hikes take the upper bound from 4.00% to 4.75%. Bid/ask 0.23/0.24, mid 23.5%. Only difference: a path that reaches 4.75% with one 50bp move and one pause would count for us and not here (priced near zero). Kalshi KXFED-27MAR-T4.50 is too wide to use (bid 0.10, ask 0.61).

J5.contract: KXCBDECISIONJAPAN-26DEC17-H25 (Hike 25bps) plus KXCBDECISIONJAPAN-26DEC17-H25P (Hike more than 25bps), December 2026 BoJ meeting
J5.match_note: Same meeting (Dec 17 to 18, 2026, decision Dec 18), same event (any hike). 25bp bid/ask 0.78/0.79 plus more-than-25bp about 0.5%. Polymarket 'Bank of Japan Decision in December?' gives 77% (25bp) plus 0.7% (50bp+), about 78%.

O4.contract: US announces end of Iranian blockade by March 31, 2027?
O4.match_note: Same event and deadline (Mar 31, 2027). Resolves on an official US announcement ending or suspending the naval blockade of Iranian ships and customers; partial exemptions do not count. Bid/ask 0.50/0.51, volume about $0.96M. Small wording gap: the market keys on the announcement, our event on the blockade ending.

F4.contract: Oracle downgraded to junk by Moody's or S&P by June 30, 2027?
F4.match_note: Same event and deadline (Jun 30, 2027): issuer or senior unsecured rating cut to BB+/Ba1 or lower. Bid/ask 0.28/0.29, thin (volume about $7.6K). Small scope gap: the market counts Moody's or S&P only, our event counts any agency, so a Fitch-only cut would count for us and not here.

F9.contract: Will the S&P 500 close in a bear market by June 30, 2027?
F9.match_note: Same threshold: an official close at least 20% below the record close (record 7,818.93 on Oct 6, 2026, line 6,255.14). Deadline is Jun 30, 2027, 30 days after our May 31. Very thin and wide (bid 0.40, ask 0.62, volume about $180), so treat as weak. The Mar 31, 2027 contract is 36.5%.

D5.match_note: Same event and deadline (a lapse in appropriations with agencies suspending operations by Dec 12, 2026; partial shutdowns count). Bid/ask 0.26/0.27. The Dec 31 contract is 31.5%, against our 30% by Dec 31. Kalshi KXGOVTSHUTDOWN-26DEC12 (shut down at 10:00 am ET on Dec 12) trades 0.24/0.25.

BB1.contract: Skin cancer vaccine FDA approved by December 31, 2027?
BB1.match_note: Same product: FDA approval of intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157/V940, Moderna and Merck) for any indication. Deadline is Dec 31, 2027, 31 days after our Nov 30, 2027. Bid/ask 0.62/0.63, volume about $198K. The Sep 30, 2027 contract is 35%.

BB2.contract: KXFDARETATRUTIDE-RET-28JAN01: When will the FDA approve retatrutide (LY3437943)? Before Jan 1, 2028
BB2.match_note: Same event, FDA approval of retatrutide; our kill test is also about the FDA filing. Deadline is Dec 31, 2027, 31 days after our Nov 30, 2027. Bid/ask 0.71/0.72. Gap in scope: the market counts any first FDA approval, while our label names obesity, sleep apnea and knee pain together. If our event needs all three indications, read this as an upper bound. The Jul 1, 2027 contract is 6.5%.
